description: StarCraft + Brood War (via Proton and gamescope)
long: StarCraft is a science-fiction real-time strategy game featuring three asymmetric factions: the human Terrans, the insectoid Zerg, and the psionic Protoss. Players gather resources, build bases, and command armies across a sprawling story campaign and competitive multiplayer. The Brood War expansion adds new units and continues the storyline.
